sources.text:
Riverside Substation Fire

A fire broke out at the Riverside Substation on 4 March 2025 and the power outage began at 02:10 that morning.

Dana Whitfield is the incident commander for the response.

Utility control room count: 12,000 customers are without power.

Actions so far: crews isolated the damaged transformer; the fire brigade extinguished the blaze; mobile generators were deployed to the hospital.

City Emergency Bulletin

The city emergency office reports that 15,000 customers are without power after the Riverside fire.

Residents should avoid the Riverside industrial area while crews work.

Hydrology Report

The Calder River flooded the lower valley. The gauge at Millbridge recorded a peak level of 7.2 metres.

The river had been rising since 10 June 2025.

Operations Situation Report

The evacuation order was issued on 11 June 2025 and 340 households were evacuated from the valley.

Emergency shelters opened: Millbridge Community Hall and Northside High School Gym.

A second gauge reading from the operations team put the peak level at 6.8 metres.

The fire is 60 percent contained.

The forestry aerial survey measured the burned area at 9,100 hectares.

14 structures have been destroyed according to the damage assessment team.

sources.text:
Spring variety trial 2026, Northfield station

Wheat plots yielded 6.8 tonnes per hectare on average, with grain protein at 12.1%.

Barley averaged 5.2 tonnes per hectare; lodging affected 8% of plots.

Oilseed rape produced 3.4 tonnes per hectare despite pigeon damage in the north block.

Maize was sown late and will only be harvested in October, so no yield figure is available yet.

Fertiliser costs rose 14% year on year.

Sampling followed the national protocol; all twelve wells were sampled twice in the quarter.

sources.text:
Autumn visitor survey, 2,140 responses

Respondents were asked to rate each gallery. The new dinosaur hall stood out: 62% of visitors rated it excellent, the highest score of any gallery since the survey began.

The average visit lasted 118 minutes, up from 94 minutes in spring, mostly because families stayed for the evening talks.

Most complaints were about queue times at the café at lunchtime, mentioned by roughly one in five respondents.

Ticket desk staffing was unchanged during the survey period.

The cloakroom moved to the north entrance in August.

sources.text:
Beta programme report, release 4.2

Over six weeks 1,300 testers used the new build daily. Stability improved markedly: the crash rate fell from 2.1% of sessions in the previous release to 0.4%.

The redesigned onboarding was finished by 71% of new testers, against 48% for the old flow.

In the open feedback, the most frequent request by far was a dark mode for the reading view.

Store screenshots are being updated by the design team.

The release is planned for the first week of December.

sources.text:
Warehouse incident report, Northgate distribution centre

At 06:40 on 3 November 2026 a reach truck working in Aisle 14 struck the upright of a pallet racking bay while reversing out of a narrow pick face, and the impact travelled along the run of connected bays.

The investigation found that the operator's rear view was blocked by an overhanging pallet on the truck's forks and that the truck's speed limiter had been switched off during a maintenance visit the week before and never re-enabled.

Two racking bays collapsed onto the aisle floor, 340 cartons of stock were damaged beyond resale, nobody was injured, and Aisle 14 stayed closed for two days while the racking was inspected and rebuilt.

The canteen will close early on Fridays during December.

New hi-vis jackets arrive next week.

sources.text:
Informe anual de la Biblioteca Municipal de Valdemoro

Los préstamos aumentaron un 18% respecto a 2025, impulsados sobre todo por la nueva sección infantil, que abrió en marzo y ya concentra casi un tercio de todas las visitas de los sábados por la mañana.

El tiempo medio de espera para reservar un ordenador bajó de 25 a 9 minutos después de instalar 42 equipos nuevos en la segunda planta, según el registro de reservas del último trimestre.

Las quejas por ruido en la sala de estudio se duplicaron, sobre todo durante la época de exámenes de junio, y el personal de sala pide más vigilancia por las tardes.

La próxima reunión del patronato será el 12 de enero.

Se agradece la colaboración de los voluntarios del club de lectura.
